# DexThemes — Full Theme Catalog

> Generated from the checked-in theme catalog for LLM and agent consumption.
> For product, authentication, and plugin guidance, see /llms.txt.

Total public static themes: 130

## API Endpoints

- Browse all themes: GET https://www.dexthemes.com/api/themes
- Generate an unapproved paired draft: POST https://www.dexthemes.com/api/generate-theme
- DeepSeek Harness apply-preparation payload: GET https://www.dexthemes.com/api/deepseek-theme?theme={id}
- DeepSeek Harness restricted MCP profile: https://www.dexthemes.com/api/deepseek-mcp
- MCP plugin: https://www.dexthemes.com/api/mcp
- Published docs: https://www.dexthemes.com/llms.txt and https://www.dexthemes.com/.well-known/openapi.json
- Generate random: GET https://acrobatic-corgi-867.convex.site/api/color-me-lucky?variant=dark|light
- Public theme page: https://www.dexthemes.com/{id}/dark|light
- Install guide: https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/how-to-install-a-codex-theme
- Theme collections: https://www.dexthemes.com/collections
- Feature documentation: https://www.dexthemes.com/features
- Articles: https://www.dexthemes.com/articles
- Theme reference: https://www.dexthemes.com/reference

## Guides, Features, Articles, and Reference

### Guides
- [Change Codex Font Size](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/change-codex-font-size) — Change Codex font size in the ChatGPT desktop app, VS Code extension, or CLI with the correct Appearance, editor, or terminal control. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/change-codex-font-size.md))
- [Change Codex UI and Code Fonts](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/change-codex-ui-and-code-fonts) — Change interface and code fonts from Codex Appearance and understand how font names behave in theme imports. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/change-codex-ui-and-code-fonts.md))
- [Codex App Themes vs CLI Themes](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-app-themes-vs-cli-themes) — Compare Codex app themes and Codex CLI themes, including desktop Appearance imports, .tmTheme files, and IDE-extension boundaries. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-app-themes-vs-cli-themes.md))
- [Codex Appearance Settings](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-appearance-settings) — Review Codex desktop Appearance settings for themes, colors, fonts, and the limits of DexThemes imports across app, CLI, IDE, web, and mobile. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-appearance-settings.md))
- [Codex Dark Mode: Does Codex Have a Dark Theme?](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-dark-mode) — Does Codex have dark mode? Use Codex app dark mode through the desktop base theme or import a DexThemes dark theme; CLI and IDE themes use separate workflows. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-dark-mode.md))
- [Codex Theme Accessibility](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-theme-accessibility) — Test text, controls, semantic colors, fonts, and dark and light variants before sharing a Codex theme. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-theme-accessibility.md))
- [Codex Theme Generator: Create a Custom Theme](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/create-a-custom-codex-theme) — Use the DexThemes Codex theme generator to build and preview dark or light palettes, then explicitly import the selected variant in Codex Appearance. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/create-a-custom-codex-theme.md))
- [Codex Theme Import Troubleshooting](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-theme-import-troubleshooting) — Diagnose incomplete payloads, variant mismatches, unsupported code theme IDs, font fallbacks, and settings handoff confusion. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-theme-import-troubleshooting.md))
- [Codex Themes Download: Desktop Imports and CLI .tmTheme Files](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-themes-download) — Download Codex themes safely: use a DexThemes import string for desktop Appearance, or a .tmTheme file only for Codex CLI syntax highlighting. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/codex-themes-download.md))
- [Create a Custom Codex Pet](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/create-custom-codex-pet) — Create and customize a floating Codex pet in the ChatGPT desktop app with the documented Pets flow, visual QA, reduced-motion checks, and rollback. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/create-custom-codex-pet.md))
- [Create Dark and Light Codex Themes](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/create-dark-and-light-codex-themes) — Design paired dark and light variants that share an identity without relying on automatic color inversion. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/create-dark-and-light-codex-themes.md))
- [Customize the Codex Status Line](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/customize-codex-status-line) — Configure the Codex CLI status line with /statusline, safe one-off tests, documented config, validation, and rollback steps. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/customize-codex-status-line.md))
- [How to Change the ChatGPT Desktop App Theme](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/change-chatgpt-desktop-app-theme) — Change the ChatGPT desktop app theme with documented Appearance controls, and learn why a Codex theme import is not established ChatGPT-mode compatibility. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/change-chatgpt-desktop-app-theme.md))
- [How to Install a Codex Theme](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/how-to-install-a-codex-theme) — Install a Codex desktop theme through an explicit review: choose a DexThemes variant, copy its complete codex-theme-v1 string, then import it in Appearance. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/how-to-install-a-codex-theme.md))
- [Install a Custom .tmTheme in Codex CLI](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/install-custom-tmtheme-codex-cli) — Install a custom .tmTheme in Codex CLI with the /theme picker, correct $CODEX_HOME path checks, safe inspection, and rollback steps. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/install-custom-tmtheme-codex-cli.md))
- [Is DexThemes Safe](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/is-dexthemes-safe) — Understand the theme import trust boundary, community provenance, account separation, and checks to perform before importing. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/is-dexthemes-safe.md))
- [Move a Codex Theme to Another Computer](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/move-a-codex-theme-to-another-computer) — Save each app theme variant as a portable import string and reinstall fonts separately on the destination computer. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/move-a-codex-theme-to-another-computer.md))

- [Share a Custom Codex Theme](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/share-a-custom-codex-theme) — Share a portable theme import string, a public theme page, or a community submission without implying automatic installation. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/guides/share-a-custom-codex-theme.md))

### Features
- [Codex Theme Import Handoff](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/codex-theme-import) — Copy a validated DexThemes import string and complete the theme change explicitly in Codex Appearance settings. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/codex-theme-import.md))
- [Codex Theme Library](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/theme-library) — Browse built-in Codex palettes, DexThemes collections, and creator-published community themes in one catalog. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/theme-library.md))
- [Color Me Lucky Theme Generator](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/color-me-lucky) — Generate an editable dark or light Codex palette from coordinated hues, then preview and import it safely. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/color-me-lucky.md))
- [Community Codex Themes](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/community-themes) — Publish original palettes, browse creator attribution, request missing variants, and report themes through DexThemes. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/community-themes.md))
- [Custom Codex Theme Builder](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/theme-builder) — Design a dark or light Codex palette with live previews, semantic colors, local drafts, and an explicit import handoff. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/theme-builder.md))
- [DexThemes Achievements and Unlocks](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/achievements-and-unlocks) — Earn account-bound reward themes through creation, community participation, qualified rankings, and supported integrations. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/achievements-and-unlocks.md))
- [DexThemes Codex Plugin and MCP App](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/codex-plugin) — Discover, create, preview, import, collect, and publish Codex themes through an implemented MCP-backed app. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/codex-plugin.md))
- [DexThemes Community Leaderboard](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/leaderboard) — Understand daily, weekly, monthly, and all-time rankings, qualified adoptions, UTC periods, and reward eligibility. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/leaderboard.md))
- [DexThemes Creator Dashboard](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/creator-dashboard) — Review private theme totals, current ranks, finalized popularity history, activity, and achievements after signing in. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/creator-dashboard.md))
- [DexThemes Open Source Project](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/open-source) — Explore, run, validate, and contribute to the MIT-licensed DexThemes website, theme catalog, API, and MCP app. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/open-source.md))
- [DexThemes Theme API](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/theme-api) — Read the public Codex theme catalog, filter exact variants, and discover the documented MCP and account surfaces. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/theme-api.md))
- [Interactive Codex Theme Previews](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/interactive-previews) — Compare dark and light palettes, accents, semantic colors, and theme details before importing a Codex theme. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/interactive-previews.md))
- [Theme Likes and Sharing](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/likes-and-sharing) — Like a theme with a signed-in account or share its exact dark or light public page without applying it. ([Markdown](https://www.dexthemes.com/features/likes-and-sharing.md))
